info.name: NHMP Hamsafar - Full Ecosystem Mobile & Operations APIs (v1)
info.description:
# National Highways & Motorway Police (NHMP) Pakistan
## Hamsafar Ecosystem - Authoritative Postman API Collection (v1.0)

This collection contains all official RESTful APIs for the NHMP Hamsafar platform.

### Included Modules:
1. **Gateway & Discovery**: Connectivity check and high-concurrency SSE stream.
2. **Commuter Road User App**: 1-Tap Google Sign-In, Email auth, profile & vehicle setup, roadside emergency SOS, real-time patrol GPS tracking, and bidirectional case chat.
3. **Uniformed Patrol Operations**: Patrol tablet authentication, Screen 02 Duty Setup with vehicle callsign binding (e.g. `P-12`), Screen 03 high-speed Redis GPS telemetry buffer, Screens 04-16 incident response lifecycle (acknowledge, en-route, arrived, request support, complete assistance, close & release), and duty conclusion.
4. **Women's Journey Safety Module (WJ-204)**: Specialized transit monitoring for female passengers aboard PSVs, milestone check-ins, silent emergency alarm, safe arrival confirmation, and 130 Control Female Desk Queue.
5. **Tablet Travel Advisories**: Fast cached advisory feeds, road closures, and emergency broadcasts.
6. **Public Travel Advisory Portal**: Public endpoints for `nhmp.gov.pk/travel-advisory` (routes, weather/fog conditions, ticker, landmarks, and GeoJSON layers).
7. **RBAC & Security Boundaries**: Zero-trust test suite verifying role boundaries (HTTP 403 for unauthorized cross-role access and HTTP 401 for missing/invalid tokens).

### Quick Start Instructions:
1. Import this file (`NHMP_Hamsafar_Ecosystem_v1.postman_collection.json`) into Postman.
2. Import `NHMP_Hamsafar_Dev.postman_environment.json` (or `NHMP_Dev_Shared.postman_environment.json`) into Postman Environments.
3. In the top-right environment selector, choose **NHMP Hamsafar Dev & Staging** (or **NHMP Dev Shared Gateway**).
4. Run **1.2 Auth: Email Registration** or **1.3 Auth: Email Login** — the Bearer token will be auto-saved to `{{commuter_token}}`.
5. Run **2.1 Auth: Official Tactical Login** — the Bearer token will be auto-saved to `{{patrol_token}}`.
6. Follow the numbered sequence to run SOS, Case lifecycle, and Women's Journey tracking!

item.name: 5. Public Travel Advisory Portal (Web & App)
item.description: Read-only travel advisory portal endpoints for nhmp.gov.pk/travel-advisory. Includes route queries, fog alerts, road closure counters, live ticker, landmarks, and GIS GeoJSON layers.

request.description: Highway routes and carriageways.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Returns a non-empty route list', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(j).length).to.be.above(100));

item.name: 5.2 Query Route Advisories (Islamabad to Lahore, M-2)

request.description: Advisories for a route; empty list with sample_mode when none exist.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Has route, counters, advisories', () => { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('route'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('counters'); pm.expect(j.advisories).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: Live alert ticker feed.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Has ticker_items array and count', () => { pm.expect(j.ticker_items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.count).to.be.a('number'); });

request.description: Map geometry for Leaflet.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Valid FeatureCollection', () => { pm.expect(j.type).to.eql('FeatureCollection'); pm.expect(j.features).to.be.an('array'); });
